newsitem.title: USA: Compaq cash balance soars to $4.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Compaq cash balance soars to $4.0 bln.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said that its cash balance in the quarter soared to $4 billion from $745 million in the previous year, as it continued its emphasis on asset management and operational improvements.
Compaq also said that its continued emphasis on asset management reduced its inventory by $1 billion to $1.1 billion, compared with inventory of $2.1 billion a year ago.
The world's largest PC maker said it increased its inventory turns to 6.5 times from 12.4 times a quarter and decreased its days of sales outstanding to 53 from 60.
Compaq also said its gross margins grew to 24.4 percent.
